[[Private/Legends|Private]] '''Tracher''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Tracher traveled to the newly-discovered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]] aboard the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Toranni]]'', as part of an Imperial exploration team. On arrival on Alluuvia, the ''Toranni'' landed on a small atoll and Tracher, Private [[Kinard]] and the rest of the team disembarked from the vessel. The group was immediately approached by a group of twenty [[Anguilla]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Alluuvia, and Tracher and the other Imperial opened fire on the group and [[Death/Legends|killed]] sixteen of them.
